dialog.body: Utilities billing, this is Priya. How can I help you?
Good morning, and thank you for taking my call. My name is Josephine Santoro. Thank you. I am calling about my water and sewer bill, which I received this week.
Sure, Ms. Santoro. What's the service address?
It is 271 Narragansett Avenue. Thank you. And I see here that the bill says "estimated" next to the reading. Estimated. I would like to know why.

Let me pull up the account. One moment. Okay, I have it. Yes, the last reading on the account was entered as an estimate, so the usage on this bill was calculated from your past consumption rather than from a fresh read of the meter.
Yes, I understood that part from the bill. Thank you. What I do not understand is why. I do not believe anyone has read that meter. I don't think anyone has been to the house.
Can you tell me where the meter is located?

It is in the crawlspace under the back of the house. Nobody goes in there. I certainly do not, and I have not seen a person from the city on my property in, well, I could not tell you how long. Thank you for asking.
Okay. That could explain it. If the reader can't get to the meter, or there's no remote read on it, the system defaults to an estimate.
Then it is an estimate on top of an estimate, and I am being charged for it. I do not think that is quite fair, with respect.
I understand. Let me look at the history. [pause] I see the previous two reads were also flagged as estimated. So it has been a few cycles without an actual reading.
Two! Well. That is what I suspected. Thank you for confirming it. I would like the reading checked again, please. Properly checked.

Yes, I can put in a request for a meter re-read. Because it's in a crawlspace, someone will need to arrange access with you. Is there a time of day that works, and is the crawlspace door accessible from outside or inside the house?

There is a small door on the outside, at the back, by the hatchway. It is not locked, I believe, but it is stiff. Mornings are best for me. Thank you. I am usually at work until about noon on weekdays, so someone would need to come after that, or else a morning when I have said so ahead of time.
Alright, I'll note afternoons after noon, outside access at the back, stiff door. And may I confirm the best number to reach you?
Certainly. It is 401-555-0199. That is the office line where I am now. I am at the rectory office at the church, doing the administrative work for the parish. I am there most days. Thank you.

Got it, 401-555-0199, I'll have the meter team call that number to schedule. Now, about the current bill. I can add a note to the account that the reading is under review, so the estimated charge is flagged until the actual read comes in.
That would be appreciated. Thank you. So I do not need to do anything about the amount at this moment?
Once the real reading is in, the account gets adjusted, up or down, based on actual usage. The note just makes sure it's looked at. I can't tell you the outcome until the read is done.
I see. Yes. Well, I am a little irritated that it has gone this long, but I do thank you for being so clear with me.
I understand, and I'm sorry for the hassle. The request is in as of now. Someone should call within a few business days.
Thank you very much, Priya. Thank you. Good day.
You too, Ms. Santoro. Bye now.
